_doc: Money format corpus; generated by tools/ci/money-format-corpus.py --write, never edited by hand. money2 = F-SYS-051 display (2 decimals half away from zero, Western grouping, sign after); amount2 = money2 without the sign; money3 = 3 decimals exact; plain3 = ungrouped ASCII 3 decimals; lakh_crore = dashboard compact figure (whole taka half away from zero, then lakh/crore 2 decimals half up). mtk is an integer count of milli-taka (1 Tk = 1,000 mtk).
